purpose: Define the initial implementation-ready information architecture for a developer-facing cockpit over DT-001 through DT-010 and AIOC governance/evidence state, without implementing a runtime console or granting new authority.
design_principles: Authority before action: every actionable surface shows the owning source, candidate/ref, scope and stop conditions before execution controls.
Source and projection are distinct: derived status cards never visually masquerade as governing repository state.
One tool, one contract: DT-001 through DT-010 remain individually named and their raw result semantics remain visible.
Evidence is candidate-bound: receipts, CI, screenshots, traces and proof links show exact candidate/source identity.
Findings are navigable but source-preserving: grouping does not erase raw severity, source or scope.
Interruption recovery is a first-class workflow, not a hidden operator procedure.
No console screen implies runtime, A2, release, deployment, tester, credential, spending or canonical-promotion authority.

navigation.persistent_safety_indicator: A nonactivation/authority strip states whether application mutation, A2 activation, release, deployment, tester access and owner-only gates are authorized; Foundation default is all false.

screens.name: Developer Cockpit Overview
screens.purpose: Answer what is active, what is healthy, what is blocked, what evidence is current, and what the exact next governed action is.
allowed_actions: navigate to tool or recovery workflow
screens.forbidden_implication: The overview cannot present a derived green summary as completed_verified unless the checkpoint completion gate and merge evidence support it.

screens.name: Current Work & Scope Authority
screens.purpose: Expose work-item authority, active substep/slice, allowed scope, exact changed-path authority when available, stop conditions, completion gate and next action.
primary_sources: PPIA backlog or governing work order
screens.forbidden_implication: Preliminary DT-002 target roots or a PREPARED capsule cannot replace an exact changed-path authority artifact.

screens.name: Repository Health & Preflight
screens.purpose: Present DT-001 doctor and DT-002 compatibility observations with raw PASS/WARN/BLOCK semantics and repository/candidate context.
screens.forbidden_implication: A PASS is readiness for the tool's declared checks only; it is not A2 activation or implementation proof.

screens.name: Fixtures & Scenario Laboratory
screens.purpose: Work with DT-004 fixture classes/projections and DT-005 deterministic scenario evidence while preserving non-authoritative and mutation boundaries.
screens.forbidden_implication: Fixture edits or expected-state injection cannot stand in for owning-domain authoritative mutation.

screens.name: Privacy & Design Quality
screens.purpose: Unify DT-006 permission-leak findings and DT-008 design-system findings without collapsing their distinct scopes.
screens.forbidden_implication: Privacy PASS is not production security certification; design-lint PASS is not complete accessibility/visual conformance proof.

screens.name: UI Evidence Workspace
screens.purpose: Plan, run/harvest and inspect DT-007 exact-candidate UI evidence and distinguish tool-test PNGs from product evidence.
screens.forbidden_implication: Synthetic CI images or stale-candidate screenshots cannot satisfy product UI evidence gates.

screens.name: Traceability & Proof Explorer
screens.purpose: Separate stable-ID occurrence discovery from explicit implementation/verification/evidence proof relationships.
major_regions: occurrence list by source root/artifact class
allowed_actions: add explicit source roots/manifests to a run
screens.forbidden_implication: Mentions, planned paths or PROVEN graph state cannot independently close a governed work item or authorize release.

screens.name: CI, Evidence Receipts & Findings
screens.purpose: Bind GitHub candidate identity, applicable hosted workflows, PR/merge state, receipts and active findings into one evidence review surface.
screens.forbidden_implication: Historical failures are not automatically current blockers, and a partial green workflow set is not a final exact-head gate.

screens.name: Recovery & Performance Harness
screens.purpose: Run/inspect DT-010 recovery probes and explicitly sourced performance budgets while preserving reference-vs-product evidence scope.
screens.forbidden_implication: Reference probes are not product recovery proof and CI/tool timing is not a product performance budget without approved budget authority.

screens.name: Interruption Recovery & AI-Team Handoff
screens.purpose: Recover the exact unfinished operation from repository state and produce a compact, provenance-rich handoff for a human or AI implementer.
screens.forbidden_implication: Conversation history, an old status card, branch existence or an open PR cannot substitute for inspected repository recovery evidence.

cross_screen_components.name: Authority Badge
cross_screen_components.purpose: Label source as governing, active-attempt, derived projection, tool evidence or generated aid.

cross_screen_components.name: Candidate Identity Chip
cross_screen_components.purpose: Show repository/ref/SHA and stale-vs-current relationship for candidate-bound evidence.

cross_screen_components.name: Source Stack
cross_screen_components.purpose: Show precedence-ordered governing and derived sources with direct navigation.

cross_screen_components.name: Finding Row
cross_screen_components.purpose: Preserve source, raw severity/state, scope, locator, candidate/input identity, blocking effect and resolution.

cross_screen_components.name: Evidence Receipt Card
cross_screen_components.purpose: Show tool/workflow, candidate, run/digest, scope, mutation flag and limitations.

cross_screen_components.name: Stop Condition Panel
cross_screen_components.purpose: Keep owner/work-order stop conditions visible beside any action that could cross an authority boundary.

requirements: All information required to distinguish authority, status and blocker state must be available without color alone.
Dense tables require keyboard-operable sorting/filtering and a linear nonvisual representation.
No core workflow may depend on hover.
Focus state and source/action relationships remain perceivable at high zoom/reflow.
Mobile/compact layouts preserve the same semantic task and authority disclosures rather than hiding safety context.
Long logs/evidence bodies may be progressively disclosed, but candidate identity, raw result and blocking state remain visible.
responsive_and_accessibility_foundation.note: Detailed component behavior and screen interaction contracts belong to the next PPIA-16 substep; Foundation locks only the semantic IA and coverage boundary.

nonactivation_boundary: This artifact is a design contract only. It does not implement a Developer Console, mutate application runtime, activate STAGE-A-A2, authorize release/deployment/tester access, use credentials/paid services, or promote canonical content.
